name: KURA den on the left wall, TROFAST and play table along the top wall with BESTÅ storage above, toy bench by the closet
notes:
Alternative, re-designed 2026-10-23: the KURA den, now with real storage. The old b had no dresser and left the floor below the window empty; that floor now holds the SMÅSTAD toy bench, and the wall above the play table takes the BESTÅ unit (F-63). 12 placed, 9 extras.
bed-1 KURA in its LOW position only (F-21: no loft bed before 6; IKEA recommends the loft for 6 and older), head on the top wall, long side on the left wall, flush: the frame above the mattress makes the den. Its rails top out at 45 5/8" and invite climbing; the canopy and the BESTÅ unit hang well above and to the side of them. F-34 open side 26.25" to the toy bench's corner, more along the rest; F-33 bedding 70.6" from the heater face.
toys-1 TROFAST on the top wall beside the KURA's head, the bedside surface (20.5"): F-32 24"+ clear in front for the boxes; no anchoring line on IKEA's page.
table-1 LÄTT on the top wall in the window corner: F-33 right end 7.25" from the heater face; its two chairs sit side by side at its front (y 19 to 30), the right one 7.5" from the heater face (furniture, 6"); not under the window (13" in from the right wall).
cabinet-1 BESTÅ shelf unit with doors, 47 1/4x16 1/2x15" (top, new): top wall above the TROFAST's end and the play table, x 58.75-106, its right end 6" short of the heater face (F-33), 17" to the side of the KURA's frame so she cannot reach it from the rails: closed storage hung above her reach for markers, paint, glue and rotation toys a parent hands down (F-63): solid LAPPVIKEN doors (no glass, F-21), hung on 2 BESTÅ suspension rails screwed into studs (extras), underside about 54" up. art-1 BLODFLÄDER (canvas, no glass) hangs between the table and the cabinet at her eye level.
bench-1 SMÅSTAD bench with toy storage (new in b), rot 180, x 67.6-103, y 74-94.5: a seat and a toy box facing the room, its back on the closet doors' swing line without entering it, the 24" in front of the closet clear (F-31); F-32 24"+ in front for the box; its end 9" from the heater face (F-33, furniture). No cushion on it, so no upholstery near the heater. Flag: assumed-position:closet.
books-1 FLISAT book display at the KURA's foot, covers facing the door, 1.5" short of the door's swing (F-31). Flag: assumed-position:door.
rug-1 VALLABY rot 90, x 46-98, y 33-72: the play floor, 14" from the heater face (F-33), out of both swings, 2" short of the toy bench.
canopy-1 LÖVA on the top wall over the KURA's head; mount it well above the 45 5/8" frame so she cannot climb the frame to it (IKEA: out of reach). lamp-1 UPPLYST inside the den on the left wall, cord fastened (IKEA). nightlight-1 TÖVÄDER and plant-1 FEJKA (artificial) on the TROFAST.
No dresser: clothes go in the 55" closet; toys in the TROFAST and the toy bench, supplies in the BESTÅ unit. Maddie is 4 (F-21): every piece within her reach is under 27" or anchored; no glass anywhere; no loft or bunk.
Walkways (F-30): door to room 46" between the book display and the toy bench; around the toy bench to the closet 37.6".
Extras: ÅSVANG (4 3/4", under KURA's 5 1/8" maximum) with the DVALA fitted sheet (up to 10"), SMÅSPORRE insert, BARNDRÖM cover, low pillow, SKOGSDUVA cushions x2 for the den, BENGTA panel (cut to clear the heater, F-33) on the HUGAD rod (assumed-position:window), BESTÅ suspension rails x2. Not placed: nothing.
Total $1,190.32: placed $892.89 + extras $297.43; prices as of 2026-10-22 (price-stale, F-02) except the BESTÅ pieces, read 2026-10-23. Flags across the layout: assumed-position:door, assumed-position:closet, assumed-position:window, heater-depth-assumed.
